pr_title: modeling_bart: 3 small cleanups that dont change outputs
pr_body:
+ Fixes #6259
+ allows a better diff if the mbart integration test breaks
+ raises a Warning in the classic "use cache when call forward" mixup (test_benchmark triggers this warning).

issue_context.title: Bart encoder with add_final_layer_norm
issue_context.body:
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/91cb95461e438dc57555c4f57f8ce95a56328036/src/transformers/modeling_bart.py#L305

I feel like it should be 
self.layer_norm = LayerNorm(config.d_model) if config.add_final_layer_norm else None

as in the BartDecoder.
https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/91cb95461e438dc57555c4f57f8ce95a56328036/src/transformers/modeling_bart.py#L486
comments: You are correct. It will be fixed in the blenderbot PR if not sooner.
